limitations: This is a robustness and certification refinement of the Langharst--Wang characterization, not a new proof of it. No dimension-only lower bound is obtained for witness-set measure, violation margin, sampling probability, or Hausdorff stability radius. The continuity argument applies to interior difference-body shifts and does not assert a continuous boundary extension. The motivating preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel observations remain a residual originality risk.
record_title: Rational robust witnesses for the Bézout simplex characterization
